title: Glowing Old Ores
description: This pack adds glowing textures to the Old Ores Textures
body:
This pack adds glowing textures to the old ores texture pack that I made. It adds the ore textures from versions 1.14–1.16. I hope you like my texture pack, and thanks!                <details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This texture pack dont needs the pack "old ores textures"

</details>
